summary: Iteration 5 (Team accounts / Appointment confirmation TAK-NIE / Password reset) tested end-to-end. Backend: 28/29 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5_team_confirm_reset.py — the only failure is a legacy-template regression (admin clinic's sms_24h stored in Mongo is missing {link_potwierdzenia}; same issue flagged as minor in iteration_4). Frontend Playwright: owner login → /nadchodzace, /zespol (invite + link box + member list + cancel invite + accept in fresh context → user-role='Recepcja'); recepcja login → no nav-team / no reset-demo-btn, /ustawienia + /szablony + /ustawienia-recallu show readonly-banner and hide save buttons, /zespol redirects to /panel; public /potwierdz/<aid> shows confirm-visit-page + confirm-yes-btn → confirm-result-yes, bad id → confirm-error; /logowanie forgot-password-link → /nie-pamietam-hasla → forgot-sent; /reset-hasla/<t> with mismatched passwords → reset-error; regression patients (32 rows) + wiadomosci badge-24h (2) + badge-inbound (6) OK. Recepcja password restored to Recepcja123! at end of pytest run (verified via login).

minor.issue: Admin clinic's sms_24h template (created pre-iteration-3) still lacks {link_potwierdzenia} placeholder. Iteration-5 requirement: sms_24h must contain {link_potwierdzenia}. Same root cause as iteration-4: GET /api/templates does not merge DEFAULT_TEMPLATES on missing keys, and no one-time backfill exists. Fix by either (a) $set-on-startup a defaults-merge for existing template docs, or (b) merge DEFAULT_TEMPLATES on read in get_templates().

Not blocking — reload/second visit displays correct counters — but suggests appt-total/appt-confirmed/appt-cancelled render before data arrives.

(nice-to-have) Guard AppointmentsPage counters against pre-data render — e.g. show '—' or skeleton until list is loaded, so counters never flash 0/0/0.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: invite_accept creates account and immediately sets httpOnly refresh/access cookies same-site=none — good. But payload.imie override always wins over inv.imie only when non-empty (line 311 uses payload.imie.strip() OR inv.imie) — correct.
server.py _apply_reply writes reminders with rodzaj='ODPOWIEDZ_PACJENTA' via raw_db (bypassing tenant filter) but sets clinic_id from appt.get('clinic_id') — verified working. Good.
sms/inbound matcher uses regex '\\D*'.join(last 6 digits) + secondary exact-9-digit compare — robust to '+48 500 111 222' vs '+48500111222' formats. Verified.
server.py still ~1465 lines — splitting into routers (appointments, team=auth, booking, sms) is overdue (repeated feedback).
GET /appointments/{aid}/public leaks appointment 'procedura' + full 'pacjent_imie'; matches spec (patient sees own visit). resend_api_key stripped via _public_settings ✓.

rca of the issue: sms_24h missing {link_potwierdzenia}: server.DEFAULT_TEMPLATES contains the correct template with the placeholder, but seed_if_empty only inserts DEFAULT_TEMPLATES when the templates collection is empty for the clinic. Admin clinic's templates doc was created before sms_24h + {link_potwierdzenia} were introduced, so its stored sms_24h remains the old string. GET /api/templates returns the stored doc verbatim (no defaults merge). Reproduction: 1) fresh recepcja login, 2) GET /api/templates as owner, 3) inspect sms_24h — still 'Przypominamy: jutro {data_wizyty} o {godzina_wizyty} masz wizytę w {nazwa_gabinetu}, {adres}. W razie zmiany planów prosimy o kontakt: {telefon_gabinetu}.' Mitigation options: (a) in get_templates(), return {**DEFAULT_TEMPLATES, **stored}; (b) run one-time startup migration that $set updates any templates doc where sms_24h missing/lacks {link_potwierdzenia}.
